newsitem.title: LATVIA: SOCCER-LATVIA BEAT BELARUS 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATVIA BEAT BELARUS 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Latvia beat Belarus 2-0 (halftime 1-0) in a World Cup group four qualifying match on Wednesday:

Latvia: 1-Oleg Karavajev, 2-Igor Troickis, 3-Vitaly Astafiev (13-Aleksandr Strasdinsh 87), 4-Mikhail Zemlinkis, 5-Juri Shevlyakov, 6-Oleg Blaganadyezhdin, 7-Valeri Ivanov, 8-Marian Pahar (12-Artur Zakreshevski 71), 9-Vitas Rimkus, 10-Vladimir Babicev (14-Imant Bleidelis, 45) 11-Andrei Shtolcers

Belarus: 1-Valeri Shantolosov, 2-Sergei Gurenko, 3-Sergei Shtanyuk, 4-Erik Yakhimovich, 5-Aleksandr Khadkevich (14-Sergei Gerasimets, 45) 6-Andrei Ostrovksy, 7-Juri Antanovich (Vyacheslav Gerashchenko, 45), 8-Radislav Orlvosky (17-Vladimir Makavsky 71), 9-Valentin Belkevich, 10-Aleksandr Metlitsky, 11-Pyotr Kachuro
